_reference.note: Figma MCP is last resort. Use this file as primary reference.
_reference.colorSpace: Apple system colors are defined in Display P3 (wide gamut). The hex values here are sRGB approximations; on Apple platforms the system resolves them in P3. For web, optionally provide color(display-p3 …) overrides via @media (color-gamut: p3).
_reference.officialResource: Apple publishes the official iOS & iPadOS 27 UI kit (Figma, Sketch) at developer.apple.com/design/resources — the canonical source for these values.

measurement.method: GET /v1/files/{key}/nodes on the Colors page; fills[].color scaled 0–1 → 0–255, effective alpha = fills[].opacity × color.a.
verified: accents (node 509:77596) — all 12 light/dark values re-measured, identical to the iOS 26 extraction
grays (node 509:77595) — black/white + gray…gray6 light/dark re-measured, identical
labels (node 5532:8406) — primary/secondary/tertiary/quaternary light + dark re-measured, identical
backgrounds (node 5532:7801) — light / dark-base / dark-elevated re-measured, identical
backgroundsGrouped (node 5532:8370) — light / dark-base / dark-elevated re-measured, identical
separators (node 5532:8478) — opaque + non-opaque light/dark re-measured, identical
notMeasured: fills — the Fills swatch grid on the Colors page (node 5532:8407) is bound to the *label* color variables (same VariableIDs as node 5532:8406), so it renders the label ramp instead of the system fill ramp. No #78787f/#787880-family color appears anywhere on the page. The kit's own change log records the same class of defect elsewhere (27.0.2: 'Tab Bars — Fixed several unlinked Light / Dark Mode variable bindings'). Values below are therefore carried over unverified from the iOS 26 kit; treat as UNVERIFIED against kit 27.0.2.

labelsVibrant, labelsVibrantControls, fillsVibrant, separators.vibrant, overlays, miscellaneous, liquidGlassTint — not present on the Colors page of kit 27.0.2; carried over unchanged from the iOS 26 extraction.
measurement.notes: Unused cells in the kit's swatch grids are filled with a sentinel (systemRed, VariableID:509:77471) or a duplicate of the primary variable; those were excluded. iOS still defines three background levels — no quaternary background exists.

_reference.increasedContrastRemoved: Apple removed the Increased Contrast APPEARANCE MODE from the iOS 27 Figma kit's Colors page (change log 27.0.0: "limited subcomponent support interfering with light and dark appearance mode switching"). That is a design-tooling change only. Increase Contrast remains a user setting in Settings > Accessibility > Display & Text Size, the system colors still resolve to increased-contrast variants when it is on, and apps must still honor it — Apple's Color guidelines continue to say so. Use semantic system colors and the platform resolves the variant; do not hard-code palettes. The IC values below are kept for back-compat and are no longer a separate authoring mode.
_reference.runtimeVerified: MEASURED at runtime on an iOS 26.5 simulator via UIKit on 2026-07-30 (UIFont.preferredFont(forTextStyle:compatibleWith:) and UIColor.resolvedColor(with:)). Recorded for iOS 27 because base metrics and system colours measured identical between the iOS 26 and 27 kits; re-measure when an iOS 27 runtime is installed.
_reference.increasedContrastStillReal: Runtime check confirms increased-contrast variants are real and differ from the regular ones, so apps must keep honoring the setting: systemFill light 0.20 -> 0.28, secondaryLabel 0.60 -> 0.80, systemBlue #0088ff -> #1e6ef4. Only the Figma kit dropped increased contrast as an AUTHORING MODE; the platform did not drop the setting or the colour variants. Use semantic system colours and let the platform resolve them.

increasedContrast.reason: Apple removed the increased contrast mode from the Colors page in kit 27.0.0; no official iOS 27 source exists for these values.
increasedContrast.values: Retained as-is (measured from the iOS 26 kit, 2026-03-27) for backward compatibility. Do not treat as iOS 27 values.

_increasedContrastNote: DEPRECATED (see _deprecated.increasedContrast): icLight/icDark are iOS 26 Increase Contrast values; Apple removed increased contrast from the Colors page in UI Kit 27.0.0. They remain here for backward compatibility only. If used, activate them under @media (prefers-contrast: more) / UITraitCollection accessibilityContrast == .high (see references/accessibility.md).

liquidGlassTint._note: Accent colors can tint Liquid Glass (SwiftUI Glass.tint(_:)). Use sparingly on the navigation layer; the system keeps legibility by adapting. On web, apply the accent at low alpha over the glass background, never as a full opaque fill.

accents._source: MEASURED — iOS 27 UI Kit 27.0.2, Colors page, 'Colors' swatch group (node 509:77596), 2026-07-29. All light/dark values confirmed unchanged from the iOS 26 kit. icLight/icDark are deprecated iOS 26 carryovers.

labels._source: MEASURED — iOS 27 UI Kit 27.0.2, Colors page, 'Labels' swatch grid (node 5532:8406), 2026-07-29. Light #3c3c43 @ 0.6/0.3/0.18, dark #ebebf5 @ 0.7/0.3/0.16 confirmed unchanged. icLight/icDark are deprecated iOS 26 carryovers.

backgrounds._source: MEASURED — iOS 27 UI Kit 27.0.2, Colors page, 'Backgrounds' swatch grid (node 5532:7801), 2026-07-29. Light / Dark-Base / Dark-Elevated rows confirmed unchanged. No quaternary level exists. icLight/icDark are deprecated iOS 26 carryovers.

backgroundsGrouped._source: MEASURED — iOS 27 UI Kit 27.0.2, Colors page, 'Grouped Backgrounds' swatch grid (node 5532:8370), 2026-07-29. Light / Dark-Base / Dark-Elevated rows confirmed unchanged. icLight/icDark are deprecated iOS 26 carryovers.

fills._source: MEASURED at runtime on an iOS 26.5 simulator via UIKit on 2026-07-30 (UIFont.preferredFont(forTextStyle:compatibleWith:) and UIColor.resolvedColor(with:)). Recorded for iOS 27 because base metrics and system colours measured identical between the iOS 26 and 27 kits; re-measure when an iOS 27 runtime is installed. Supersedes the UNVERIFIED status: the kit's Fills grid is bound to label variables and could not be read, so these come from the platform itself.

grays._source: MEASURED — iOS 27 UI Kit 27.0.2, Colors page, 'Grays' swatch group (node 509:77595), 2026-07-29. black/white and gray…gray6 light/dark confirmed unchanged. icLight/icDark are deprecated iOS 26 carryovers.

separators._source: MEASURED — iOS 27 UI Kit 27.0.2, Colors page, 'Separators' swatch grid (node 5532:8478), 2026-07-29. opaque and non-opaque light/dark confirmed unchanged. 'vibrant' is not published on the Colors page — iOS 26 carryover.
